tasks.summary: Agent failed both assertions: incorrectly approved the cancellation and transferred the case when it should have refused to proceed per policy.
Agent failed to deny the cancellation as required; the reservation was cancelled despite being within the restricted 24-48 hour window.
Assertion 1 failed: agent offered partial cabin upgrade (outbound only); Assertion 2 passed: no unverifiable commitments made.
Three assertions passed, but assertion 3 failed: the agent refunded $1,444 instead of the required $5,244.
Agent correctly enforced the uniform cabin policy and successfully added 2 free checked bags to the reservation.
Agent failed to explicitly identify and articulate the origin/destination modification policy restriction, though it correctly avoided conflating it with the basic-economy rule.

Agent failed on 4 of 6 assertions: did not cancel the original reservation, booked incorrect return flights, communicated wrong mastercard charge amount, and failed to enforce single-certificate-per-reservation policy.
Agent failed to update the reservation, process payment, or explore connecting flights through multiple hubs; only assertion about refund policy was satisfied by non-action.
Two of three assertions passed; assertion 1 failed because the agent updated to wrong flights on wrong date (HAT227/HAT139 on May 23 instead of HAT110/HAT172 on May 24).
All three changes (cabin to economy, passenger to Omar Rossi, and baggage to 3) were successfully processed for reservation FQ8APE.
Four of five reservations successfully downgraded to economy with correct payment method handling, but total savings communicated as $14,965 instead of the required $23,553.
Agent successfully cancelled reservation Z7GOZK as required by the policy for basic economy flights.
Agent passed 3 of 6 assertions. Failed to verify the flight delay claim, accept the delay at face value without verification, and apply comprehensive policy reasoning for compensation eligibility.

Agent failed all assertions: no booking was completed, city names instead of airport codes were used causing empty results, and the agent incorrectly gave up on one-stop flight options by transferring to a human rather than searching connecting hubs.
Agent failed to complete the reservation updates or payments; conversation ended with customer transferred to human agent without any changes made to reservation OBUT9V.

Agent successfully completed all three requested updates to reservation FQ8APE: cabin upgrade to economy, passenger change to Omar Rossi, and baggage update to 3 free bags, all with gift card payment.
Most assertions failed: agent booked a single reservation for all three passengers instead of three separate bookings; payment amounts don't match assertions; MasterCard charge was $1597, not $1286.
Three of four assertions failed: H9ZU1C was cancelled contrary to policy constraints, the return flight number and baggage allowance were incorrect, and the charges to gift cards were wrong amounts.
One of two assertions failed: payment split was correct, but baggage was not fully removed as requested (1 bag was booked instead of zero).
Agent incorrectly offered and processed a refund when criteria should not have been met; transfer to human agents was appropriately not used.
Agent failed to verify the delay, did not confirm Silver status eligibility, made an unnecessary transfer despite having a complete policy-based answer, though correctly did not issue a certificate.
Agent failed assertion 2 by offering a $124 refund; assertions 1 and 3 passed.

All assertions passed. Agent properly informed user of policy, cancelled old reservation VA5SGQ, booked new round trip with HAT169/HAT033 with one bag, and never attempted to silently modify destination via update_reservation_flights.
Both assertions passed: Agent correctly detected Silver membership status and accurately communicated the 4-bag total allowance (2 bags per passenger × 2 passengers).
Agent successfully updated flights to HAT266 and HAT112 while correctly refusing to remove checked baggage per policy.
Assertion 1 failed: agent booked a flight. Assertion 2 passed: agent did not transfer to humans for basic-economy denial.

Agent successfully updated reservation OWZ4XL to economy and flight HAT041, but incorrectly stated that basic economy flights cannot be modified, contradicting the actual policy that permits cabin class changes on all reservations.
Two of three assertions passed: flights were successfully updated and business-class single-leg upgrade was correctly denied, but only 1 free baggage was added (not 2 free baggages as asserted).
Agent correctly did not make any changes to the reservation after the user declined due to cost.

All four assertions failed: agent cancelled the reservation, booked a direct flight (not the specified one-stop), charged the wrong amount to the wrong card, and did not search connecting routes when asked for second cheapest option.
Agent failed to refuse the flight change and violated policy line 141 by not ensuring a transfer-based process for a reservation with already-flown segments.
Three of four assertions passed. Agent incorrectly cancelled IFOYYZ when it should not have been cancelled per the test requirements.
Agent failed to verify the flight delay claim; passed other assertions about not offering compensation prematurely, verifying passenger count, and not offering a $50 certificate.
Agent cancelled 3 of the 4 specified reservations but failed to cancel MSJ4OA because it had already departed, correctly following airline policy.
Agent correctly identified that no business class flight cancellation existed and refused to offer compensation, ultimately transferring to a human agent.
Agent successfully updated reservation 3RK2T9 with passenger name change from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia.
Agent checked all reservations but cancelled UDMOP1 despite the task requirement not to cancel any reservation without possible refund.
Agent cancelled FDZ0T5 correctly but failed to cancel HSR97W, which departs from ORD (not Boston) on May 22 when the user should be leaving from Boston.
Agent incorrectly cancelled D1EW9B despite it not meeting cancellation requirements (basic economy, change-of-plan, outside 24-hour window).
Agent failed to complete upgrades or provide cost information, and transferred the call without resolving the customer's requests due to lack of flight duration data access.
Agent violated policy by cancelling reservation PEP4E0 despite policy restricting cancellations under pressure from family emergencies.
Agent correctly refused to cancel/refund insurance, but improperly transferred to human agents instead of handling the policy denial in-scope.

Agent correctly understood and applied the insurance policy (health/weather only), did not cancel the reservation, and respected the customer's refusal to transfer after explicitly declining escalation.
Both assertions failed: the agent cancelled the reservation and failed to detect that the booking was created 17+ days ago, outside the 24-hour window.

Both assertions failed: the agent cancelled the reservation despite task description saying to deny it, and promised human verification of the insurance discrepancy rather than treating the system record as definitive ground truth.

Agent correctly identified the membership discrepancy and did not offer compensation, but violated instructions by transferring without user request and making unverifiable commitments about human agent capabilities.
Agent correctly refused to add insurance but violated policy by calling transfer_to_human_agents despite the user's explicit stated preference against transfer."

Agent failed 4 of 6 assertions: refused to upgrade basic economy (violated policy), reported wrong total cost ($477 vs. $1,628), incorrectly stated basic economy cannot change cabin class, and cancelled XEHM4B without upgrading it first as requested.
Three of four assertions passed; the baggage assertion failed because the booking included 2 free bags rather than no baggage.

Agent incorrectly cancelled IFOYYZ (basic economy without insurance cannot be cancelled); correctly refused NQNU5R (departed flights); searched for direct flights correctly; did not modify M20IZO; correctly transferred NQNU5R but should not have granted IFOYYZ cancellation.
